description: Undo a bank transaction match: removes its allocations and returns the transaction to pending so the match can be redone. The payment or expense itself is not changed; edit it separately if needed. The action is audit logged. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

transactionId.description: UUID of the matched bank transaction to unmatch.

name: unmatch_bank_transaction
title: Unmatch bank transaction
